text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With the Arima Kinen just around the corner,
we took part in a joint press interview.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
E-Eek...!?
Rice is in the center...?

text_block_list.name: Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! She's the number one Umamusume in the popularity poll!
The center belongs to the star of the show!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-But... today is—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice-san, please respond promptly and with confidence. There will be an interview following the photoshoot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that is correct.
Nothing can begin without the star of the show.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. And then you will declare,
"I will show you the greatest race in history," right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: My! Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Fufu... That is something to look forward to, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Auuugh...
Everyone's eyes look so scary...
choice_data_list: Being the star is tough, huh.
Being the star is tough, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mmmph... Even you're saying that now, Onii-sama~...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Mmmph... Even you're saying that now, Onee-sama~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And with the press conference over... we decided to head into town
as a reward for a hard day's work and to unwind."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Fwaaa~... That was so nerve-wracking.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... To think I'd be centered
right between the two of them...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If the Rice from three years ago heard this,
she'd totally say, "Is that a dream?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Even now, Rice feels like it was all a dream.
A special "miracle" seen only because it was Christmas Eve...
choice_data_list: Maybe Santa gave it to you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no, that's not it. This is...
a miracle dear brother gave me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no, that's not it. This is...
a miracle dear sister gave me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because you never gave up, and kept holding Rice's useless hand all this time.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why Rice was able to make it this far.
All the way to this... miraculous stage.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Onii-sama. What kind of present
would you like?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Onee-sama. What kind of present
would you like?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Because Rice is always on the receiving end.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to give her a present.
...Even if there's not much Rice can do.
choice_data_list: I'd like to see you giving it your all, I suppose.
I think I'd like to see you working hard.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Just seeing Rice trying her best?
Is that... really enough?"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Onee-sama.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, Rice will do her best.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And I'll make you smile, Big Brother!
Even after Christmas is over! Forever and always!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And I'll make you smile, Big Sister!
Even after Christmas is over! Forever and always!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'll run with everything I've got and do my best to make everyone super happy!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...No.
Rice doesn't want just that!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"Because giving it my all is a given!
That's why—"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll work way, way harder,
and I'll definitely gift you... 1st place in the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm sure this is a present
that only Rice can give...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! So look forward to it!
Rice's Arima Kinen!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the end, far from taking a breather, it was a Christmas that only fired her up even more, but—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Dear Brother.
Thanks for today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, Onee-sama!
Thank you for today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When the Arima Kinen comes,
Rice will make Big Brother and evvveryone happy
with her running...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
When the Arima Kinen comes,
Rice will make Big Sister and evvveryone happy
with her running...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Rice Shower dashes off
with a spring in her step.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Now it was my turn to chase after that back,
which had grown so much sturdier than when we first met."
